recognize_zh: 低倍切片中有多個小型萎縮濾泡，中央是淡粉紅色玻璃樣化的生發中心，外圍小淋巴球一圈圈同心圓排列形成洋蔥皮樣（onion-skin）套膜區，濾泡間富含血管；這是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型低倍表現。
features: Multiple small atretic follicles scattered in a diffuse lymphoid background
Regressed germinal centers that are pale and eosinophilic with hyalinized material
Expanded mantle zones with concentric onion-skin layering of small lymphocytes
Prominent interfollicular vascularity with small vessels
No sinuses or sheets of large atypical cells evident at this low magnification
describe_en: Low-power section of a lymphoid lesion shows multiple small atretic follicles with pale, hyalinized, regressed germinal centers surrounded by well-developed mantle zones arranged in concentric onion-skin layers. The interfollicular areas are vascular and populated by small lymphocytes, and no sheets of atypical large cells are identified. Cellular detail such as plasma cell content and twinning of germinal centers cannot be evaluated at this power. Findings are consistent with hyaline-vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: May show similar regressed follicles but typically has sheets of interfollicular plasma cells and, if HHV-8-related, LANA-1-positive plasmablasts in mantle zones, with systemic symptoms.
Neoplastic follicles are crowded, back-to-back and lack mantle zones and polarization, without hyalinized centers or onion-skin mantles.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Expanded mantles can surround naked germinal centers, but the cells are monotonous, cyclin D1-positive and CD5-positive.
Shows follicle involution with vascular proliferation, but occurs with HIV infection and marked lymphocyte depletion rather than expanded onion-skin mantles.
